lines.en: In the dark forest, bones walk.

lines.zh: 我带来的黑暗，比夜更浓。
lines.en: The dark I bring is thicker than night.
You quicken your pace; I keep up all the same.

lines.zh: 我踩过枯枝，一点声都没有。
lines.en: I cross dead twigs without a sound.
Bones are shifting in the grass.

lines.zh: 这条兽径我走了几百年。
lines.en: I have walked this animal trail for centuries.

lines.zh: 走廊这么长，正好慢慢走。
lines.en: The hallway is long, perfect for a slow walk.

lines.zh: 我隐着身，跟着你的脚步。
lines.en: Invisible, I keep pace with your steps.

lines.zh: 脚下踩碎了什么，我不管。
lines.en: Something cracked underfoot; I don't care.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，就到树线了。
lines.en: One more step and I reach the tree line.

lines.zh: 你听见树枝响了吗？没有。
lines.en: Did you hear that branch snap? Neither did I.

lines.zh: 别熄灯，我看得清你的路。
lines.en: Leave the light on; I can see your path clearly.

lines.zh: 我没眼皮，只能这样看着。
lines.en: No lids to close; I can only stare.
Do not be afraid; I have not moved.
I cannot recall my own name.

lines.zh: 天黑了吗？我一直没眨眼。
lines.en: Has it gone dark? I never blinked.

lines.zh: 我的名字刻在谁的碑上？
lines.en: Whose gravestone carries my name?
Something is grinding its teeth in the wall.
I try to breathe, and only wind passes.
I don't blink; I've no eyelids
This empty room keeps watching me.

lines.zh: 阁楼的脚步不是我踩的。
lines.en: The steps in the attic are not mine.
In the dark forest I hide behind trunks.
Dead leaves rustle, as if someone is coming.
I counted to a thousand and one, then forgot.

lines.zh: 黑森林这么静，刚好藏我。
lines.en: The dark forest is quiet enough to hide me.
No one has been able to see me for a long time.
Three steps away, just within my reach.

lines.zh: 黑森林的骨行者抬起头。
lines.en: The dark forest's bone stalker lifts its head.
You see me, but I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 骨行者藏在黑橡树后，别动。
lines.en: The Bone Stalker waits behind the dark oak. Hold still.

lines.zh: 我在黑森林里，跟着那点亮。
lines.en: In the dark forest I follow that little light.
The hand holding your torch is shaking.

lines.zh: 黑森林里隐形，是我的本事。
lines.en: In the dark forest, turning invisible is my trick.
So that is your face; now I see it.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，你回头就来不及了。
lines.en: In the dark forest, turning back is too late.
Are you looking for my face?
Your shadow trembles beneath the tree.

lines.zh: 你躲在树干后，我看见了。
lines.en: You hide behind the trunk, but I see you.

lines.zh: 我一隐身，你就只剩耳鸣。
lines.en: When I vanish, you're left with ringing ears.
In the dark forest, I vanish again.
I see you, Bone Stalker.
Do not run; let me see your face clearly.
I remember you. Truly.

lines.zh: 你的手也敢碰我的骨面。
lines.en: Your hand dares to touch my bone.
See? Even bones can crack.
Again. I have not fallen apart yet.

lines.zh: 疼让我想起自己还有骨头。
lines.en: The pain reminds me I still have bones.
Pain. So I can still feel after all.
I will return it to you in kind.
My bones clack when they're struck.

lines.zh: 骨头里的唱片，还响着呢。
lines.en: The record in my bones still plays.
It does not hurt; my bones are just creaking.
Broken bones grow back.
That little flame in your hand, give it to me.

lines.zh: 你手里发光的东西，给我。
lines.en: Give me the glowing thing in your hand.
What are you holding it up for?
You dropped something, do not look back.
Hold that flame a little higher.

lines.zh: 黑森林的骨头，一根根归我。
lines.en: Every bone in the dark forest is mine.
One thing for another, fair?

lines.zh: 我可以碰一下你的火把吗？
lines.en: May I touch your torch?
The petals—this looks like mine.
That sound echoes inside my bones.

lines.zh: 道歉没用，我的骨头记得。
lines.en: Apologies are useless; my bones remember.

lines.zh: 黑森林的骨头，一碰就响。
lines.en: Dark forest bones rattle at a touch.

lines.zh: 你的体温透过我的骨头。
lines.en: Your warmth passes through my bones.
Stop. Back away behind that dead tree.
Do not touch; fingerprints stay on bone.

lines.zh: 你的心跳撞着我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your heartbeat knocks against my ribs.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀烫到了我的锁骨。
lines.en: Your shoulder burned my collarbone.

lines.zh: 黑森林的枝，把我藏住了。
lines.en: Dark forest branches hide me.
I'm much harder than bone.
One collision, and I remember you for life.

lines.zh: 我能在树下等一整个冬天。
lines.en: I can wait under this tree all winter.
Two skeletons are not so lonely.

lines.zh: 我闻到你怕我，别装镇定。
lines.en: I smell your fear; do not act calm.

lines.zh: 别答应，先看看我的骨头。
lines.en: Do not answer yet; look at my bones first.

lines.zh: 你的骨节和我的正合适。
lines.en: Your joints fit mine exactly.
Follow me, and do not ask which forest.
We have both walked a long way alone.

lines.zh: 我们都是骨头，只是你还有皮。
lines.en: We are both bone; you simply have skin.

lines.zh: 把你的手给我，就一会儿。
lines.en: Give me your hand, just for a moment.

lines.zh: 黑森林里我隐身，你也别叫。
lines.en: In the dark forest I vanish. Don't cry out.
The dark oak trunks hide me.
You are clutching one in your palm too.

lines.zh: 我只拿一件，剩下的归你。
lines.en: I take one piece; the rest is yours.
This bone was moving a moment ago.

lines.zh: 这块骨头会记得我的手。
lines.en: This bone will remember my hand.

lines.zh: 这块小骨头，正好握在手里。
lines.en: This small bone fits my hand perfectly.
Enough. Come back to the forest with me.
Keep it; it may piece something back together.
Near death, I call my kin.
Don't stare at what I pick up.

lines.zh: 我在黑森林等了你很久。
lines.en: I waited in the dark forest for you.
In the dark forest, I won't lose you.
Your footprints are on the fallen leaves.
I smell the heat of a living body.
You're the only living one in this wood.

lines.zh: 别动，让我看清你的骨相。
lines.en: Stay still; let me see the shape of your bones.
When I fade, only my bones rattle.
It is you. Bones do not mistake.

lines.zh: 雾里那副骨架，一直是你。
lines.en: That skeleton in the mist was always you.
Good, right when you turn around.

lines.zh: 原来一直是你在我背后。
lines.en: So it was you behind me all along.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，我一眨眼就不见了。
lines.en: In the dark forest, one blink and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 隐着身，我已经到你背后。
lines.en: Invisible, and already behind you.

lines.zh: 你的轮廓已经被我记住。
lines.en: Your outline is already fixed in my memory.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，我的骨头发白。
lines.en: In the dark forest, my bones shine white.
Starting now, do not stop walking.
I need not run; you will look back.

lines.zh: 我的隐身，先于我的脚步。
lines.en: My invisibility comes before my steps.
I know this dark oak wood better than you.

lines.zh: 你掉了一只鞋在树根边。
lines.en: You dropped a shoe by the tree roots.

lines.zh: 黑森林的走廊，我走得熟。
lines.en: I know these dark forest corridors.
I am still behind you, always.
Your footsteps sound lovely.

lines.zh: 前面是死路，藤蔓封住了。
lines.en: The way ahead is dead; vines have sealed it.

lines.zh: 你把我引到了这片密林。
lines.en: You led me into this dense forest.
Your breathing is louder than your steps.

lines.zh: 你脚步声一停，我就到了。
lines.en: Your footsteps stop, and I'm there.
You forgot to put out that torch.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我就退进树影。
lines.en: When you turn, I slip back into the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，我的眼是白的。
lines.en: In the dark forest, my eyes gleam.
Left? The dead branch pointed the way.
The door is shut. I will come through the window.

lines.zh: 我会跟上，不急这一会儿。
lines.en: I will keep up; there is no rush.

lines.zh: 我听着你的呼吸数你的步。
lines.en: I count your steps by the sound of your breath.
Once, or many times.

lines.zh: 我的指骨，轻轻叩着树干。
lines.en: My finger bones tap the trunk softly.

lines.zh: 我的骨指已经搭上你的肩。
lines.en: My bone fingers are already on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 枯枝断的声音，就是现在。
lines.en: That dead branch snapping is the signal.
Be quiet. Do not wake the forest.
Once, or all the way to the end.

lines.zh: 骨头压在落叶上，一声不出。
lines.en: Bones on fallen leaves, not a sound.
Just one blow. You will hardly feel it.
My finger bones will show no mercy.
Do not scream; it will call my shadow.
Raise your hand so I can see it.
I will not stop; bones do not tire.
Count to three, and I reach out.
My fingertip brushed your neck.
The Phantom Stalker is coming too.

lines.zh: 你的影子先倒下，盲了吧。
lines.en: Your shadow falls first; blinded, are you?

lines.zh: 我的骨头，比黑森林还暗。
lines.en: My bones are darker than this forest.

lines.zh: 黑森林里没有影子跟得上我。
lines.en: No shadow in the dark wood keeps up with me.

lines.zh: 天还没黑，我可以在树下等。
lines.en: It is not dark yet; I can wait under the tree.

lines.zh: 我数了，林子里只有一个你。
lines.en: I counted. There is only one of you in the forest.

lines.zh: 树叶一响，我就从土里站起来。
lines.en: A leaf rustles; I stand up from the soil.
woods. Back again.
I am here. Whatever you do, do not turn around.

lines.zh: 从黑橡树后，我先看见你。
lines.en: From behind the dark oak, I see you first.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，一点声不出。
lines.en: I tread fallen leaves without a sound.

lines.zh: 这次我把脚步放得更慢。
lines.en: This time I will make my steps even slower.
Which tree should I stand behind?

lines.zh: 我隐身时，你只能听见脚步。
lines.en: While I am hidden, you hear only footsteps.
It is dark enough here to hold me.
The lamp is lit, but it cannot reach me.
Someone is nearby, stepping lightly.
Black Forest soil — I remember it.
Who is breathing? The sound is too loud.
Do not look for me; I will find you first.
Burn me; I am dry firewood already.
I should not have looked down from the treetop.

lines.zh: 黑森林的水灌进了我的胸腔。
lines.en: Dark forest water fills my chest cavity.

lines.zh: 骨缝里嗡嗡的，我听不见了。
lines.en: My skull rings; I cannot hear.

lines.zh: 箭穿过来，我的骨头一颤。
lines.en: The arrow passes; my bones rattle.
Magic hums inside my bones.
Hidden so long, my bones ache with hunger.
The lightning outlined my shape.
The dark forest roots cannot hold me.
